code.why: The runtime credentialDoor issues and reuses the World application key on boot; Kadewerk supplies its own dashboard-issued account keys. The life does not boot a consumer application. This World-only bootstrap is invoked by the runtime (resend/src/manifest.ts credentialDoor).
A domain left without required DNS records can fail after 72 hours (https://resend.com/docs/add-a-domain). Hanne installs every record before verification, so no domain in this story times out.
The host process around fetch is outside the in-process life and example measurements; conformance exercises this standalone server.
Dub sends ISO scheduledAt through its native Resend request (demand.json). This life sends transactional messages immediately; a future scheduled_at is an optional documented send mode.
The scheduled_at send option releases on its timestamp (SendEmailRequest). This life has no future-scheduled message, so the optional release clock has no subject.

state.why: Resend documents email.clicked (https://resend.com/docs/webhooks/email-clicked); Kadewerk turns click tracking off for program mail and no link click occurs in this story.
A domain without all DNS records can fail after 72 hours (https://resend.com/docs/add-a-domain). Hanne installs each record and the story verifies both domains.
The documented scheduled_at mode is used by Dub (demand.json); all messages in this customer life send immediately.
This is the release of the documented scheduled_at mode; the customer life contains only immediate messages.
